title: Carspace
tagline: Real-Time Second-Hand Automobile Marketplace with Zero-Install PWA
summary: High-performance hybrid e-commerce marketplace for certified pre-owned vehicles — engineered with sub-100ms multi-facet inventory search, real-time Firestore database synchronization, and native-feeling offline PWA mobile capabilities.
description: Used car marketplaces frequently suffer from sluggish inventory indexing, outdated pricing states, and heavy app download barriers for casual car buyers. Carspace was conceived to eliminate this friction through an instantaneous, app-like web platform connecting certified dealerships with prospective buyers.

Engineered the full-stack architecture on React and Firebase Cloud Firestore. Implemented client-side indexing and real-time document listeners that push vehicle availability, price adjustments, and inspection status updates across all connected clients in under 100 milliseconds without page refreshes.

Architected the application as an installable Progressive Web App (PWA) with smart service worker caching strategies, enabling seamless offline browsing of previously viewed car models, smooth touch gestures, and full home-screen installability across iOS and Android.

features.title: Sub-100ms Faceted Search
features.desc: Ultra-fast multi-parameter query engine allowing simultaneous instant filtering across make, model, odometer mileage, price bracket, and transmission type.

features.title: Real-Time Firestore Inventory Sync
features.desc: Live websocket-backed document updates that automatically reflect newly listed vehicles, sold reservations, and price changes without reloading.

features.title: Zero-Install PWA Mobile Parity
features.desc: Installable to mobile home screens with service worker offline caching, responsive touch gestures, and native app appearance.

features.title: Dealership & Buyer Inquiry Flow
features.desc: Streamlined in-app direct inquiry pipeline connecting verified buyers to dealership representatives with one-tap WhatsApp and call actions.

highlights: High-speed multi-faceted vehicle filtering with sub-100ms response time
Real-time cloud database architecture powered by Firebase Firestore
Installable Progressive Web App with offline caching and native mobile UI
Streamlined dealership contact routing and vehicle inspection badges

title: D-MART Retail Intelligence
tagline: Interactive Big-Data Retail Intelligence & Multi-Store SKU Profitability Modeling
summary: An interactive retail analytics and intelligence platform processing massive D-MART store transaction volumes — transforming raw point-of-sale datasets into actionable gross margin forecasts, SKU velocity trends, and regional sales drill-downs.
description: Supermarket chains and FMCG retail giants generate millions of point-of-sale records daily, yet store directors and inventory managers often lack real-time visual tools to identify high-margin SKU clusters and regional revenue leakages. D-MART Analysis was created to bridge this data-to-decision gap.

Engineered high-throughput automated Python ETL pipelines using Pandas and NumPy to cleanse, normalize, and aggregate high-volume raw sales records. Built optimized in-memory query routines that allow instant cross-dimensional analysis across departments, product categories, and promotional price brackets.

Crafted an executive-ready React dashboard pairing decision-first UX with high-performance interactive charts. Business stakeholders can run multi-variable scenario modeling, compare regional warehouse performance side-by-side, and isolate fast-moving consumer goods with zero analytical friction.

features.title: Automated Python ETL Pipeline
features.desc: Ingests, deduplicates, and structures hundred-thousand-row retail datasets into normalized relational schemas in seconds.

features.title: Multi-Dimensional SKU Velocity Drill-Downs
features.desc: Real-time exploration of sales volume, markdown impact, and seasonal velocity across groceries, FMCG, and apparel.

features.title: Interactive Gross Margin Modeling
features.desc: Visual sensitivity analysis allowing retail executives to simulate margin outcomes based on wholesale supplier discount adjustments.

features.title: Executive Decision-First Dashboard
features.desc: Clean, distraction-free visual reporting system highlighting key outlier categories, inventory risks, and top revenue drivers.

highlights: End-to-end data pipeline processing 100K+ transactional records with zero data loss
Interactive multi-attribute filtering and scenario modeling in React
Automated SKU velocity categorizations and supplier margin optimization
Clean visual presentation tailored for executive and store manager review

title: D7 Sports
tagline: Immersive Virtual Reality Sports Arena with Locked 90 FPS Spatial Immersion
summary: An adrenaline-fueled virtual reality sports simulation engineered in Unity 3D — pairing physics-driven athletic gameplay and dynamic motion graphics with a locked 90 FPS rendering pipeline and 3D spatial audio for nausea-free immersion.
description: Virtual reality applications in sports entertainment frequently struggle with latency spikes, motion disorientation, and unnatural physics feedback that break user presence. D7 Sports was developed to deliver an authentic athletic arena experience where movement, ball physics, and spatial acoustics mimic physical stadium dynamics.

Engineered within Unity 3D using custom C# physics solvers and optimized polygon budgets. Implemented high-efficiency draw-call batching, baked lightmaps, and occlusion culling algorithms that maintain a locked 90 FPS framerate with sub-12ms motion-to-photon latency across VR headsets.

Integrated 360° HRTF spatial audio positioning and high-impact motion graphics sequences modeled in Blender. Players experience directional crowd roar, realistic ball impact acoustics, and intuitive spatial UI that enhances immersion without cluttering the athlete's visual field.

features.desc: Aggressive polygon optimization and GPU draw-call batching guaranteeing butter-smooth rendering and zero simulator sickness.

features.title: 360° HRTF Spatial Acoustics
features.desc: Real-time binaural sound engine accurately mapping stadium echoes, ball impacts, and crowd feedback to user head rotation.

features.title: Physics-Driven Athletic Mechanics
features.desc: Fine-tuned haptic feedback and custom C# ball collision solvers replicating realistic trajectory and kinetic response.

features.title: Dynamic Motion Graphics & Spatial UI
features.desc: Futuristic spatial scoreboards and visual effect sequences designed in Blender and Unity VFX Graph.

highlights: High-performance virtual sports arena built in Unity 3D and C#
Locked 90 FPS performance across standalone and PC VR headsets
Realistic HRTF 3D spatial audio positioning and sound design
Intuitive spatial UI and custom motion graphics sequences in Blender

title: Interior Design 3D WebGL

summary: An in-browser 3D architectural visualization and interior design customizer built with Three.js and WebGL — enabling clients to explore photorealistic living spaces in real-time 3D, customize wood and textile finishes, and inspect daylight simulations with zero plugins required.
description: Traditional interior design approvals rely on static 2D renders or cumbersome CAD files that fail to convey true spatial proportions and natural lighting variation. This prototype was designed to bring interactive 3D architectural exploration directly into modern web browsers without requiring software installation or specialized hardware.

Optimized geometry hierarchies, progressive texture streaming, and mobile touch camera controls to achieve a silky 60 FPS across both desktop workstations and mobile phones, setting a benchmark for lightweight, browser-based spatial e-commerce and architectural walk-throughs.

features.title: Smooth Orbit & First-Person Camera

title: PricePulse
tagline: Automated Multi-Store Price Intelligence & Historical Fluctuation Tracker
summary: An automated price intelligence and multi-store product comparison engine — continuously scraping e-commerce marketplaces to deliver historical price variance tracking, side-by-side merchant comparisons, and algorithmic optimal-buy triggers.
description: E-commerce pricing on electronics and high-demand goods fluctuates hourly across major retailers, making it exhausting for consumers and procurement teams to secure genuine bargains without constant manual tracking. PricePulse was built to automate price discovery and predict optimal buying windows.

Engineered a resilient distributed scraping pipeline using Node.js and headless browser automation via Puppeteer. Implemented intelligent request throttling, user-agent rotation, and DOM parsing routines that systematically collect pricing, stock availability, and merchant ratings across multiple competitive storefronts without triggering anti-bot blocks.

Developed a fast React interface powered by Chart.js for time-series visualization. Users can paste any product link or search keywords to view historical price trajectory charts, receive lowest-price-ever alerts, and compare shipping and tax totals across stores in a single, decision-first view.

features.title: Automated Multi-Retailer Scraping Engine
features.desc: Headless Puppeteer workers running scheduled price extraction jobs across major e-commerce storefronts with rate-limit evasion.

features.title: Historical Price Trajectory Graphing
features.desc: High-performance Chart.js visual trends plotting 30-day, 90-day, and all-time price variances to expose artificial markups.

features.title: Smart Optimal-Buy Signal Alerts
features.desc: Algorithmic alert engine that evaluates statistical standard deviations to notify buyers when an item reaches an all-time low.

features.title: Side-by-Side Merchant Comparison
features.desc: Aggregated matrix breaking down base price, shipping fees, seller ratings, and expected delivery windows in real-time.

highlights: Continuous multi-vendor price scraping powered by Node.js and Puppeteer
Interactive historical price trajectory charting with Chart.js and React
Automated optimal buy-signal calculations and instant price-drop alerts
Clean, decision-first interface comparing merchant fees and delivery times
